current_content_summary: POST-SPLIT content (see version_diffs_found): this file is now a SMALL (102-line) theory of TOTAL maps ('a,'b) map (every key has a value; from CoreMap), providing: tofun/offun (isomorphism between ('a,'b) map and 'a -> 'b functions), get/set notations, cst (constant map), map (functorial map), eq_except, and merge (pointwise combination of two maps via a 3-argument function). It requires only AllCore and CoreMap.
import_repair_note: MAJOR STRUCTURAL CHANGE, r2025.02 (#605, 'split SmtMap into SMT Array and finite map'): prior to this release, SmtMap was evidently a larger theory that also covered finite-domain map material (the kind of thing FMap.ec now provides on its own, built ON TOP OF this slimmed-down SmtMap). A proof written against a pre-r2025.02 EasyCrypt that does `require import SmtMap` expecting finite-map operations (dom, fdom, filter with a 'finite support' notion, etc.) will need to switch those specific references to FMap instead -- SmtMap.ec itself no longer has them. Anything using only total-map operations (get/set/cst/map/eq_except/merge) should be unaffected by name, though it's worth double-checking against this current (102-line) file since the surrounding theory may have been reorganized around it. SEPARATELY, r2024.09: SmtMap also lost `FMapCost`, `cget`, `cget_pos`, `cin`, `cin_pos`, `cset`, `cset_pos` and `from` to the cost-logic removal (commit 41c2667f). Do not confuse those 8 with the 131 that left in r2025.02 for FMap: the cost names have no replacement anywhere and the repair is to delete their uses, whereas the r2025.02 names are all still available via FMap.
